card.name: Contrast with earlier findings
card.fires_on: Words inside a sentence that turns against an earlier finding, such as after "However," or "but not in", or in "did not" and "other studies". Seen in drug interaction and animal study text.

modes.label: After However
modes.description: Words right after a sentence that begins with However, introducing a different study result.
modes.example: However,<< in>> a follow-up study in normal subjects,

modes.label: Negated finding
modes.description: The word not or the species named after "but not in" where a result fails to match another.
modes.example: Other studies do<< not>> show a significant statistical association.

modes.label: Other studies or species
modes.description: A word naming a different study or animal that gave a different result.
modes.example: Major fetal abnormalities were observed in rats, but not in<< mice>> or rabbits

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that mark a different or opposite case, such as 另一种 and 的那种.
card.plain: It lights up where the text says another study or animal did not show the same result.
